settings.title: Settings
settings.pageDesc: Configure your application, email, storage and backup settings
settings.generalDesc: Application name, default language and accounting contact
settings.smtpDesc: Outbound email used for review reports and invoice notifications
settings.smtpFromHint: Appears in the "From" field of every outgoing email
settings.smtpTestDesc: Send a test email to verify your SMTP settings are working
settings.smbDesc: Network file share (Samba / Windows) where PDF review reports are saved
settings.smbHostHint: IP address or hostname of the file server
settings.smbBasePathHint: Subfolder within the share — files are organized by customer and facility
settings.smbUsernameHint: User with write access to the share
settings.templatesDesc: Email templates for review reports (sent to customers) and accounting emails. One per type can be marked as default.
settings.templatesEmpty: No templates yet. Create one to get started.
settings.templateDefaultHint: Automatically pre-select this template when uploading a review or sending to accounting
settings.backupDesc: Automated database backups to protect your data
settings.backupEnabledHint: Run automatic backups on the configured schedule
settings.backupScheduleHint: Cron expression — 0 2 * * * = every day at 02:00 · 0 2 * * 0 = every Sunday
settings.backupPathHint: Relative to the application root, or an absolute path on the server
settings.backupFilesDesc: Existing backups stored at the configured path
settings.alertsDesc: Configure email digests and escalation alerts for overdue reviews
settings.digestEnabledHint: Send a periodic summary of open reviews and pending invoices
settings.digestEmailFallback: Falls back to accounting email if empty
settings.escalationEnabledHint: Notify managers and admins when reviews stay open too long
settings.escalationDaysHint: Send an alert when a review has been pending for this many days
settings.appNameHint: Shown in the browser tab title and outgoing email templates
settings.defaultLanguageHint: Default language applied to new user accounts
settings.accountingEmailHint: Invoices are forwarded to this address when sent to accounting
settings.logoDesc: Upload your company logo — shown on the login screen and in PDF reports
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPG or SVG · Max 5 MB
settings.imapSectionHint: Enable inbox monitoring to see a live unread count badge in the toolbar. Uses the same account as SMTP.
settings.imapPortHint: 993 = SSL/TLS · 143 = STARTTLS · leave empty to disable
settings.backupToNasHint: After each backup, copy the file to the configured SMB share
settings.backupNasPathHint: Path within the SMB share where backups are stored — e.g. Backups or Servio/Backups (defaults to Backups/)
settings.backupKeepRecentHint: How many of the newest backups to keep, locally and on the NAS. Backups outside these limits are permanently deleted after the next backup runs.
settings.backupKeepMonthlyHint: From older backups, keep the newest one per month for this many months. 0 = keep none.
settings.auditLogRetentionMonthsHint: Audit log entries older than this are exported nightly to backups/archive (and NAS if enabled), then removed from the database. 0 = keep forever.
settings.restoreBackupDesc: Upload a .tar.gz (or .sql) backup file to restore the database. This will overwrite all existing data.
settings.restoreUploadHint: Select a .tar.gz backup file exported from this application
settings.deleteBackupConfirm: This file will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
settings.restoreConfirmDesc: This will overwrite all current data with the contents of the backup file. This action cannot be undone.
settings.restoreSuccess: Database restored successfully. Restart services to apply changes.
settings.restartServicesDesc: Restart the backend service — useful after a database restore or configuration change
settings.restartConfirmDesc: This will briefly restart the backend. The app will be unavailable for a few seconds.
settings.updatesDesc: Check for new versions and apply updates from the GitHub repository
settings.dockerUpdateNotice: This instance is running inside Docker. Updates are applied by rebuilding and restarting the containers:
settings.applyConfirmDesc: This will pull the latest code, rebuild the application and restart the backend. The app will be briefly unavailable. Continue?
settings.updateSuccess: Update complete. Waiting for server to restart...
settings.checkFailed: Could not reach the remote repository.
settings.rolesDesc: Configure what each role can access. Admin always has full access.
